audit.whatIsWrong: Four places say Slicing Maelstrom cancels Pop Blossom outright — 'hard-cancels your channel the instant you leap', 'stun you out of the channel mid-air', 'Hold R to cancel your Pop Blossom channel'. Riot's text for Slicing Maelstrom is only 'summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage'. The stun is not on the ultimate.
audit.why: Mark of the Storm is the passive: Kennen stuns enemies he hits three times with his abilities. Slicing Maelstrom applies marks repeatedly, which is why the stun feels like it comes from the ult — but it needs three marks. That changes the counterplay from 'never commit while his R is up' to 'never step in already carrying marks', which a player can actually act on.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, wants.foe[1] and content.mid now describe the mark-stacking stun instead of an instant channel cancel.
sources: kit: Kennen Q/W/E all apply Mark of the Storm

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stay his — he farms with Q safely and your E (Tangle-Barbs) is your only reach, but it's telegraphed and he's got move speed from W (Electrical Surge) to dodge it. At 6 your Pop Blossom is the bait everyone fears, but Kennen is the wrong target: he holds his own R (Slicing Maelstrom) to stun you out of the channel mid-air. Your realistic play is to disguise as an ally, set the ult unseen, and only commit if his R is down — otherwise just shove with Q re-blooms and roam, because you win the map, not this duel.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 stay his — he farms with Q safely and your E (Tangle-Barbs) is your only reach, but it's telegraphed and Lightning Rush's move speed slides him out of it. At 6 your Pop Blossom is the bait everyone fears, but Kennen is the wrong target: Slicing Maelstrom stacks Mark of the Storm on you and the third mark stuns. Disguise as an ally, set the ult unseen, and only commit while you are carrying no marks — otherwise shove with Q re-blooms and roam, because you win the map, not this duel.

notes: The claim I removed is the important one: nothing in Riot's text makes Slicing Maelstrom a channel-cancel. It applies Mark of the Storm repeatedly and the passive stuns on the third mark, so a Neeko who commits clean can finish the leap. Whether Pop Blossom's airborne portion can be interrupted at all is not answerable from the kit files — I did not assert either way. Also unchanged: the full layer says 'he/his' for Kennen while the content layer matches; that is consistent here, no fix needed.
